# rs-query

> TanStack Query v5 parity for Rust — declarative, cache-aware async state management portable to every quoin-supported UI framework.

https://github.com/elcoosp/rs-query

## Overview

- [Page Not Found](/404/): The page you requested does not exist in the rs-query documentation.
- [rs-query — TanStack Query v5 parity for Rust](/): Declarative, cache-aware async state management for Rust, portable to every quoin-supported UI framework.

## Tutorials — learning-oriented

- [Your First Query](/tutorials/first-query/): Go from an empty Rust crate to a running, cached, cancelable query with rs-query.
- [Queries in a Quoin App](/tutorials/quoin-app/): Wire rs-query into a gpui, leptos, dioxus, xilem, or floem application through the quoin reactive layer.

## Guides — task-oriented how-tos

- [Headless Devtools](/guides/devtools/): Inspect cache rows and a filtered transition timeline with the feature-gated devtools module.
- [Framework Bindings](/guides/framework-bindings/): Observe queries and mutations from any quoin-supported framework — gpui, leptos, dioxus, xilem, or floem.
- [Hydration and Dehydration](/guides/hydration/): Move query state between a server and client with dehydrate_state and hydrate_with_options, including error redaction.
- [Infinite Queries and Pagination](/guides/infinite-queries/): Fetch bidirectional, windowed page lists with InfiniteQuery, page params, and max_pages.
- [Installation](/guides/install/): Add rs-query to a Rust project with a sibling quoin checkout and optional feature gates.
- [Working with Keys and Filters](/guides/keys-and-filters/): Build hierarchical query keys and drive bulk cache operations with filters, predicates, and refetch types.
- [Mutations and Optimistic Updates](/guides/mutations/): Run mutations with on_mutate rollbacks, scoped serialization, cache callbacks, and invalidation wiring.
- [Offline Support and Network Modes](/guides/offline-and-network-modes/): Configure NetworkMode semantics, drive the OnlineManager, and resume paused work on reconnect.
- [Persisting the Cache](/guides/persistence/): Save queries individually or the whole client, with expiry, buster versioning, and retry strategies.
- [Running Queries](/guides/queries/): Spawn, execute, prefetch, and cancel queries — the four imperative entry points.
- [Streamed Queries](/guides/streamed-queries/): Accumulate a stream of partial results into one cache entry with streamed_query and RefetchMode.

## Reference — information-oriented API docs

- [QueryClient](/reference/client/): The cache, deduplication table, defaults, and runtime entry points — every QueryClient method.
- [Errors and Cancellation](/reference/errors-and-cancellation/): Every QueryError variant, its TanStack counterpart, and the cancellation toolkit.
- [Framework Hooks](/reference/hooks/): The ten quoin bindings — use_query, use_mutation, use_infinite_query, use_queries, and the activity hooks.
- [InfiniteQuery API](/reference/infinite-queries/): InfiniteQuery, InfiniteData, spawn_infinite_query, and InfiniteQueryObserver signatures.
- [QueryKey and Filters](/reference/keys-and-filters/): QueryKey construction and hashing, the four filter structs, snapshots, and the match functions.
- [Mutation API](/reference/mutations/): Mutation, MutateOptions, MutationState, MutationCache, MutationScope, and MutationObserver signatures.
- [Observers and Result Flags](/reference/observers/): QueryObserver, QueriesObserver with combine, and the QueryResultFlags surface.
- [Persistence and Hydration API](/reference/persistence-and-hydration/): Dehydrate/hydrate, the per-query persister, the client persister, and broadcast sync — every type and option.
- [QueryOptions](/reference/query-options/): The complete QueryOptions surface — staleness, GC, retries, triggers, network mode, and constants.
- [Query and QueryState](/reference/query/): The Query builder and the QueryState state machine with every status enum.
- [Runtime, Network, and Managers](/reference/runtime-and-network/): The QueryRuntime seam, PoolRuntime and ExecutorRuntime, NetworkMode, OnlineManager, and the three managers.
- [Utilities](/reference/utilities/): Streamed query config, Updater and functional updates, and the devtools types.
